text.body: atha pulastyasmṛtiḥ varṇāśramadharmavarṇanam kurukṣetre mahātmānaṃ pulastyamṛṣayo'bruvan tāṃśca dharmānprakārāṃśca no vada smārtamāgamam ||1|| evaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ pratyuvāca sarvāṃstān pṛcchata ṛṣīn paṃcadhā vāsthitaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥ ||2|| varṇadharmaḥ smṛtastveka āśramāṇāmataḥ param varṇāśramastṛtīyastu guṇanaimittikastathā ||3|| varṇamekaṃ samāśritya yo'dhikāraḥ pravartate varṇadharmaḥ sa vijñayo yathopanayanaṃ triṣu ||4|| yastvāśrayaṃ samāśritya padārthaḥ saṃvidhīyate ukta āśramadharmastu bhikṣāpiṇḍādikaṃ tathā ||5|| ubhayasya nimittena yo vidhiḥ sampravartate naimittikaḥ savijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhiryathā ||6|| brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vānaprasthaśca bhikṣukaḥ ukta āśramadharmastu rājadharmastu pañcamaḥ ||7|| varṇadharmaścaturṇāṃ yaḥ āśramāṇāṃ tathaiva ca dvayoḥ sādhāraṇo dharmo yaścāsaudvayaśeṣabhāk ||8|| ijyādhyayanadānāni yathāśāstraṃ sanātanam brahma kṣatriya vaiśyānāṃ sāmānyo dharma ucyate ||9|| yājanādhyayane rājño bhūtānāñcābhirakṣaṇam pāśupālyaṃ kṛṣiścaiva vaiśyasyājīvanaṃ smṛtam ||10|| śūdra sya dvijaśuśrūṣā dvijānāmanupūrvaśaḥ śūdrā ca vṛttistatsevā kāruṇyaṃ karma tathaiva ca ||11|| gurauvāso'gniśuśrūṣā svādhyāyo vrata dhāraṇiṃ trikālasnāpitā bhṛtyai gurau prāṇāṃtikī sthitiḥ ||12|| tadabhāve gurusute tathā sabrahmacāriṇi kāmato vā samānatvaṃ svadharmo brahmacāriṇaḥ ||13|| samekhalo jaṭī daṇḍī muṃḍī gurugṛhāśrayaḥ anyathā grahamedhitvaṃ gacchetkāmato vāśramāṃtaram ||14|| agnihotropacaraṇaṃ jīvanañca svakarmabhiḥ dharmadāneṣu kāmyeṣu sarvatra janavikrayāḥ ||15|| devapitr! yatithibhyaśca bhūtānāmānukampitā śrutismṛtyuktasaṃskāro dharmo'yaṃ gṛhamedhinaḥ ||16|| jaṭitvamagnihotritvaṃ bhūśayyājinadhāraṇam vanevāsaḥ payomūlanīvārakaṇavṛttitā ||17|| pratigrahanivṛttiśca triḥsnānaṃ maunadhāraṇam devatātithipūjā ca dharmo'yaṃ vanavāsinām ||18|| sarvāraṃbhaparityāgo bhaikṣānnaṃ vṛttamūlatā niṣparigrahatā dro haḥ samatā sarvajantuṣu ||19|| priyāpriyapariṣvaṅgaḥ sukhaduḥkhāvikāritā sa bāhyābhyantarāśaucaṃ niyamo vratakāritā ||20|| sarvendri yasamāhāro dhāraṇādhyānanityatā bhāvaśuddhistathetyevaṃ parivrāḍdharma ucyate ||21|| ahiṃsā satyavādaśca satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā kṣamā varṇināṃ liṅgināñcaiva sāmānyo dharma ucyate ||22|| svajñānaṃ hṛdi sarveṣāṃ dharmo'yaṃ varṇiliṅginām udṛṣṭārtho dvividhaḥ prokto dṛṣṭārthaśca dvitīyakaḥ ||23|| ubhayārthastṛtīyaśca nyāyamūlaścaturthakaḥ ubhayāvyavahāraśca daṃḍadhāraṇameva ca ||24|| tulyārthānāṃ vikalpaḥsyānnyāyamūlaḥ prakīrttitaḥ vede tu vidito dharmaḥ smṛtau tādṛśa eva tu ||25|| anuvākaḥ śrutisūktaṃ kāryārthamiti mānavāḥ tadarthaśca prayāso'yaṃ sa ca sevyaḥ phalārthinā ||26|| uktaḥ pañca vidho dharmaḥ śreyo'bhyudayahetukaḥ puruṣāṇāṃ yathāyogaṃ sa ca sevyaḥ phalārthinā ||27|| sadyastu prauḍhabālāyāmanyathā vatsarācchaciḥ pradātā yāṃ trirātreṇa dattāyāṃ pakṣiṇī bhavet ||28|| iti pulastyaproktaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ samāptam
